name: Shrink Wrap
summary: A download-as-ZIP button that vacuum-packs your files in a plastic bag, heat-seals it and saves a real ZIP
about: Shrink Wrap builds a real ZIP file in the browser. Tick the files you want (five sample files are ready, and you can add or drop your own), name the bundle and press Pack: the files hop into a clear bag, a nozzle sucks the air out until the plastic hugs the stack, and a hot bar presses a crimped seal while every file's CRC-32 is worked out. A label lands with the true ZIP size and the file downloads, ready for any unzip tool.
how: Tick or untick the files; press Add files or drop your own on the card (up to 50 MB in all).
Type a name for the bundle.
Press Pack: watch the vacuum and the heat seal while each file is read and checked.
The label shows the ZIP's real size and the file is saved to your downloads.
